+#!/usr/bin/python
+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+ANSIBLE_METADATA = {'metadata_version': '1.1', 'status': ['preview'], 'supported_by': 'community'}
+
+DOCUMENTATION = '''
+---
+module: netapp_e_drive_firmware
+short_description: Upgrade NetApp E-Series drive firmware
+description:
+  - Uploads drive firmware files and upgrades compatible drives whose firmware differs from the supplied version.
+  - Drive firmware files must be obtained from NetApp support for E-Series arrays.
+extends_documentation_fragment:
+  - netapp.eseries
+options:
+  firmware:
+    description: Local paths to drive firmware files on the Ansible controller.
+    required: true
+    type: list
+    elements: path
+  wait_for_completion:
+    description: Wait until every targeted drive has completed its upgrade.
+    type: bool
+    default: false
+  ignore_inaccessible_drives:
+    description: Skip offline or unavailable drives instead of failing.
+    type: bool
+    default: false
+  upgrade_drives_online:
+    description: Upgrade drives while they are accepting I/O.
+    type: bool
+    default: true
+notes:
+  - Check mode uploads firmware to obtain controller compatibility information, but does not initiate an upgrade.
+  - The task returns before the upgrade completes unless I(wait_for_completion) is true.
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = '''
+- name: Upgrade compatible drive firmware
+  netapp_e_drive_firmware:
+    api_url: "https://array.example.com:8443/devmgr/v2"
+    api_username: admin
+    api_password: "{{ array_password }}"
+    ssid: '1'
+    firmware:
+      - /srv/firmware/drive_firmware.dlp
+    wait_for_completion: true
+'''
+
+RETURN = '''
+upgrade_in_process:
+  description: Whether the initiated upgrade is still running when the module exits.
+  returned: always
+  type: bool
+'''
+
+import os
+import time
+
+from ansible.module_utils._text import to_native
+from ansible.module_utils.netapp import NetAppESeriesModule, create_multipart_formdata
+
+
+class NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware(NetAppESeriesModule):
+    WAIT_TIMEOUT_SEC = 3600
+    POLL_INTERVAL_SEC = 5
+    IN_PROGRESS = ('inProgress', 'inProgressRecon', 'pending', 'notAttempted')
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        options = dict(
+            firmware=dict(type='list', elements='path', required=True),
+            wait_for_completion=dict(type='bool', default=False),
+            ignore_inaccessible_drives=dict(type='bool', default=False),
+            upgrade_drives_online=dict(type='bool', default=True),
+        )
+        super(NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware, self).__init__(options, supports_check_mode=True)
+        args = self.module.params
+        self.firmware_list = args['firmware']
+        if not self.firmware_list:
+            self.module.fail_json(msg='At least one drive firmware file must be provided for array %s.' % self.ssid)
+        self.wait_for_completion = args['wait_for_completion']
+        self.ignore_inaccessible_drives = args['ignore_inaccessible_drives']
+        self.upgrade_drives_online = args['upgrade_drives_online']
+        self.upgrade_in_progress = False
+        self._upgrade_list = None
+
+    def _path(self, suffix):
+        return 'storage-systems/%s/firmware/drives%s' % (self.ssid, suffix)
+
+    def upload_firmware(self):
+        for path in self.firmware_list:
+            filename = os.path.basename(path)
+            try:
+                headers, payload = create_multipart_formdata([('file', filename, path)])
+                rc, _ = self.request('files/drive', data=payload, method='POST', headers=headers)
+                if not 200 <= rc < 300:
+                    raise ValueError('HTTP %s' % rc)
+            except Exception as error:
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to upload drive firmware %s to array %s: %s' %
+                                      (path, self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _items(value):
+        if value is None:
+            return []
+        if isinstance(value, list):
+            return value
+        if isinstance(value, dict):
+            for key in ('driveFirmwareFiles', 'firmwareFiles', 'firmwareCompatibilities', 'compatibilities', 'compatibility',
+                        'files', 'firmware', 'drives', 'driveStates', 'driveFirmwareState'):
+                if isinstance(value.get(key), list):
+                    return value[key]
+            return [value]
+        return []
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _refs(entry):
+        for key in ('driveRefList', 'compatibleDrives', 'driveRefs', 'drives', 'driveRef'):
+            if key in entry:
+                value = entry[key]
+                if isinstance(value, dict):
+                    value = value.get('driveRef', [])
+                if not isinstance(value, list):
+                    value = [value]
+                return value
+        return []
+
+    def upgrade_list(self):
+        if self._upgrade_list is not None:
+            return self._upgrade_list
+
+        try:
+            rc, response = self.request(self._path(''))
+            if not 200 <= rc < 300:
+                raise ValueError('HTTP %s' % rc)
+            compatibilities = self._items(response)
+        except Exception as error:
+            self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to complete compatibility and health check. Array %s: %s' %
+                                  (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+
+        selected = {os.path.basename(path): [] for path in self.firmware_list}
+        for compatibility in compatibilities:
+            if not isinstance(compatibility, dict):
+                continue
+            filename = compatibility.get('filename', compatibility.get('fileName', compatibility.get('name')))
+            if filename not in selected:
+                continue
+            target_version = compatibility.get('firmwareVersion', compatibility.get('version',
+                                               compatibility.get('targetVersion', compatibility.get('firmwareRevision'))))
+            for candidate in self._refs(compatibility):
+                if isinstance(candidate, dict) and (candidate.get('compatible') is False or candidate.get('supported') is False):
+                    continue
+                ref = candidate.get('driveRef', candidate.get('id')) if isinstance(candidate, dict) else candidate
+                if not ref:
+                    continue
+                try:
+                    rc, drive = self.request('storage-systems/%s/drives/%s' % (self.ssid, ref))
+                    if not 200 <= rc < 300:
+                        raise ValueError('HTTP %s' % rc)
+                except Exception as error:
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to retrieve drive information. Array %s, drive %s: %s' %
+                                          (self.ssid, ref, to_native(error)))
+                if not isinstance(drive, dict):
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to retrieve drive information. Array %s, drive %s: invalid response.' %
+                                          (self.ssid, ref))
+                inaccessible = drive.get('offline', False) or not drive.get('available', True) or drive.get('removed', False)
+                if inaccessible:
+                    if self.ignore_inaccessible_drives:
+                        continue
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Drive %s is offline or unavailable on array %s.' % (ref, self.ssid))
+                current_version = drive.get('firmwareVersion', drive.get('softwareVersion'))
+                version = (candidate.get('firmwareVersion', target_version) if isinstance(candidate, dict) else target_version)
+                if current_version is None:
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to retrieve drive information. No current firmware version for drive %s on array %s.' %
+                                          (ref, self.ssid))
+                if version is None:
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to complete compatibility and health check. No target version for %s on array %s.' %
+                                          (filename, self.ssid))
+                if current_version == version:
+                    continue
+                online_capable = (candidate.get('onlineUpgradeCapable', candidate.get('onlineUpgradeSupported',
+                                  candidate.get('isOnlineUpgradeCapable')))
+                                  if isinstance(candidate, dict) else None)
+                if online_capable is None:
+                    online_capable = compatibility.get('onlineUpgradeCapable', compatibility.get('onlineUpgradeSupported',
+                                     compatibility.get('isOnlineUpgradeCapable', drive.get('onlineUpgradeCapable',
+                                     drive.get('isOnlineUpgradeCapable')))))
+                if self.upgrade_drives_online and online_capable is False:
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Drive is not capable of online upgrade. Array %s, drive %s.' % (self.ssid, ref))
+                if ref not in selected[filename]:
+                    selected[filename].append(ref)
+
+        self._upgrade_list = [{'filename': filename, 'driveRefList': refs}
+                              for filename, refs in selected.items() if refs]
+        return self._upgrade_list
+
+    def wait_for_upgrade_completion(self):
+        targets = {ref for item in self.upgrade_list() for ref in item['driveRefList']}
+        deadline = time.time() + self.WAIT_TIMEOUT_SEC
+        while targets:
+            try:
+                rc, response = self.request(self._path('/state'))
+                if not 200 <= rc < 300:
+                    raise ValueError('HTTP %s' % rc)
+                states = self._items(response)
+            except Exception as error:
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to retrieve drive status. Array %s: %s' % (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+            for state in states:
+                if not isinstance(state, dict):
+                    continue
+                ref = state.get('driveRef', state.get('id'))
+                if ref not in targets:
+                    continue
+                status = state.get('status', state.get('state', state.get('upgradeStatus')))
+                if status == 'okay':
+                    targets.remove(ref)
+                elif status not in self.IN_PROGRESS:
+                    self.module.fail_json(msg='Drive firmware upgrade failed. Array %s, drive %s, status %s.' %
+                                          (self.ssid, ref, status))
+            if not targets:
+                break
+            if time.time() >= deadline:
+                self.module.fail_json(msg='Timed out waiting for drive firmware upgrade. Array %s, drives %s.' %
+                                      (self.ssid, ', '.join(sorted(targets))))
+            time.sleep(min(self.POLL_INTERVAL_SEC, max(0, deadline - time.time())))
+        self.upgrade_in_progress = False
+
+    def upgrade(self):
+        pending = self.upgrade_list()
+        if not pending:
+            return
+        try:
+            rc, _ = self.request(self._path('/initiate-upgrade'), data={'firmware': pending,
+                                 'onlineUpgrade': self.upgrade_drives_online}, method='POST')
+            if not 200 <= rc < 300:
+                raise ValueError('HTTP %s' % rc)
+        except Exception as error:
+            self.module.fail_json(msg='Failed to upgrade drive firmware. Array %s: %s' % (self.ssid, to_native(error)))
+        self.upgrade_in_progress = True
+        if self.wait_for_completion:
+            self.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+
+    def apply(self):
+        self.upload_firmware()
+        pending = self.upgrade_list()
+        if pending and not self.module.check_mode:
+            self.upgrade()
+        self.module.exit_json(changed=bool(pending), upgrade_in_process=self.upgrade_in_progress)
+
+
+def main():
+    NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware().apply()
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+# (c) 2026, Ansible contributors
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from unittest import mock
+
+from ansible.modules.storage.netapp.netapp_e_drive_firmware import NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware
+from units.modules.utils import AnsibleExitJson, AnsibleFailJson, ModuleTestCase, set_module_args
+
+
+class TestNetAppESeriesDriveFirmware(ModuleTestCase):
+    def make_module(self, **params):
+        args = dict(api_username='admin', api_password='secret', api_url='https://array/devmgr/v2',
+                    ssid='1', firmware=['/tmp/fw.dlp'])
+        args.update(params)
+        set_module_args(args)
+        return NetAppESeriesDriveFirmware()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def response(path, data=None, method='GET', headers=None):
+        if path == 'storage-systems/1/firmware/drives':
+            return 200, [{'filename': 'fw.dlp', 'firmwareVersion': 'B',
+                          'driveRefList': ['one', 'two']},
+                         {'filename': 'other.dlp', 'firmwareVersion': 'C', 'driveRefList': ['three']}]
+        if path.endswith('/drives/one'):
+            return 200, {'driveRef': 'one', 'firmwareVersion': 'A', 'available': True}
+        if path.endswith('/drives/two'):
+            return 200, {'driveRef': 'two', 'firmwareVersion': 'B', 'available': True}
+        raise AssertionError(path)
+
+    def test_upgrade_list_filters_filename_and_current_version(self):
+        module = self.make_module()
+        with mock.patch.object(module, 'request', side_effect=self.response) as request:
+            expected = [{'filename': 'fw.dlp', 'driveRefList': ['one']}]
+            self.assertEqual(module.upgrade_list(), expected)
+            self.assertEqual(module.upgrade_list(), expected)
+            self.assertEqual(request.call_count, 3)
+
+    def test_upload_error_identifies_file_and_array(self):
+        module = self.make_module()
+        with mock.patch('ansible.modules.storage.netapp.netapp_e_drive_firmware.create_multipart_formdata',
+                        return_value=({'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data'}, b'data')):
+            with mock.patch.object(module, 'request', side_effect=ValueError('invalid firmware')):
+                with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as result:
+                    module.upload_firmware()
+        message = result.exception.args[0]['msg']
+        self.assertIn('Failed to upload drive firmware', message)
+        self.assertIn('/tmp/fw.dlp', message)
+        self.assertIn('array 1', message)
+
+    def test_compatibility_and_drive_lookup_errors(self):
+        module = self.make_module()
+        with mock.patch.object(module, 'request', side_effect=ValueError('controller unavailable')):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as result:
+                module.upgrade_list()
+            self.assertIn('Failed to complete compatibility and health check.', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+
+        module = self.make_module()
+
+        def failed_lookup(path):
+            if path.endswith('/firmware/drives'):
+                return 200, [{'filename': 'fw.dlp', 'firmwareVersion': 'B', 'driveRefList': ['one']}]
+            raise ValueError('drive missing')
+
+        with mock.patch.object(module, 'request', side_effect=failed_lookup):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as result:
+                module.upgrade_list()
+            self.assertIn('Failed to retrieve drive information.', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+
+    def test_check_mode_reports_change_without_upgrade(self):
+        module = self.make_module(_ansible_check_mode=True)
+        with mock.patch.object(module, 'upload_firmware') as upload, \
+                mock.patch.object(module, 'upgrade_list', return_value=[{'filename': 'fw.dlp', 'driveRefList': ['one']}]), \
+                mock.patch.object(module, 'upgrade') as upgrade:
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleExitJson) as result:
+                module.apply()
+            self.assertEqual(result.exception.args[0]['changed'], True)
+            self.assertEqual(result.exception.args[0]['upgrade_in_process'], False)
+            upload.assert_called_once_with()
+            upgrade.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_upgrade_and_wait_only_for_targeted_drive(self):
+        module = self.make_module(wait_for_completion=True)
+        module._upgrade_list = [{'filename': 'fw.dlp', 'driveRefList': ['one']}]
+        states = iter([(200, [{'driveRef': 'other', 'status': 'failed'},
+                              {'driveRef': 'one', 'status': 'inProgress'}]),
+                       (200, [{'driveRef': 'one', 'status': 'okay'}])])
+
+        def request(path, data=None, method='GET'):
+            if path.endswith('/state'):
+                return next(states)
+            self.assertEqual(path, 'storage-systems/1/firmware/drives/initiate-upgrade')
+            self.assertEqual(data['onlineUpgrade'], True)
+            return 202, {}
+
+        with mock.patch.object(module, 'request', side_effect=request):
+            module.upgrade()
+        self.assertEqual(module.upgrade_in_progress, False)
+
+    def test_online_capability_and_inaccessible_drives(self):
+        module = self.make_module()
+
+        def response(path):
+            if path.endswith('/firmware/drives'):
+                return 200, [{'filename': 'fw.dlp', 'firmwareVersion': 'B',
+                              'driveRefList': [{'driveRef': 'one', 'onlineUpgradeCapable': False}]}]
+            return 200, {'driveRef': 'one', 'firmwareVersion': 'A', 'available': False}
+
+        with mock.patch.object(module, 'request', side_effect=response):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as result:
+                module.upgrade_list()
+            self.assertIn('offline or unavailable', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+
+        module = self.make_module(ignore_inaccessible_drives=True)
+        with mock.patch.object(module, 'request', side_effect=response):
+            self.assertEqual(module.upgrade_list(), [])
+
+        module = self.make_module()
+
+        def online_response(path):
+            code, data = response(path)
+            if path.endswith('/drives/one'):
+                data['available'] = True
+            return code, data
+
+        with mock.patch.object(module, 'request', side_effect=online_response):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as result:
+                module.upgrade_list()
+            self.assertIn('Drive is not capable of online upgrade.', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+
+    def test_wait_failure_and_timeout(self):
+        module = self.make_module()
+        module._upgrade_list = [{'filename': 'fw.dlp', 'driveRefList': ['one']}]
+        with mock.patch.object(module, 'request', return_value=(200, [{'driveRef': 'one', 'status': 'failed'}])):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as result:
+                module.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+            self.assertIn('Drive firmware upgrade failed.', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])
+
+        module.WAIT_TIMEOUT_SEC = 0
+        with mock.patch.object(module, 'request', return_value=(200, [{'driveRef': 'one', 'status': 'pending'}])):
+            with self.assertRaises(AnsibleFailJson) as result:
+                module.wait_for_upgrade_completion()
+            self.assertIn('Timed out waiting for drive firmware upgrade.', result.exception.args[0]['msg'])
